lines: Intelligence had come in that a mafia organization in a certain country was connected to a domestic demon group.
An order was issued to deal with the situation swiftly, but due to the geopolitical climate, the Taimanin could not act openly.
Consequently, a separate organization was to operate on the ground, while the Taimanin were to provide backup as collaborators, per Principal Asagi's orders.
Me
I wonder which organization we're partnering with... Considering the circumstances, it probably won't be an official body...
As I arrived on the scene pondering this, I was quickly proven right.
Balalaika
Long time no see, Kotaro.
At the location I visited, hostilities had already begun, with bullets flying everywhere.
Amidst the chaos, a woman stood calmly and called out to me. I knew her.
Me
Balalaika, it's been a while. So the organization helping us is Hotel Moscow, I see.
Balalaika
Yes, I received word from Asagi. We had no intention of letting them run wild, so this is a stroke of luck for us.
She leisurely smoked a cigar in her mouth, yet a killing intent leaked from her words.
Me
I couldn't help but swallow hard.
In the past, I had served as her attendant.
She was a benefactor who taught me many things, yet I still found my spine straightening involuntarily.
Balalaika
Heh, what's the matter, Kotaro? Are you nervous?
Me
S-somewhat... I mean, are you sure it's safe for you to be out on the front lines like this, Balalaika?
I was certainly intimidated by her aura, but the sound of bullets slicing through the air also made my legs weak.
However, even in such a situation, Balalaika and her subordinates remained completely composed.
Subordinate 1
Right wing, advance to the designated point. After deployment, we will suppress the enemy's core.
Subordinate 2
Report of a large demon appearing. Special warheads are loaded and ready.
Balalaika
I know, but that giant is a decoy. Have you located the human strike team? Drive them in the opposite direction!
Subordinate 2
Understood!
We suppress the mafia members with tactics, while the demons mixed in among them are dealt with using the intelligence we provided and special equipment.
Even for someone like me, who is accustomed to fighting demons, their movements are nothing short of perfect.
Me
I knew they had strong organizational skills, but this is beyond what I expected...
I thought I understood after serving as their bodyguard before, but watching them fight on their own turf fills me with fresh astonishment.
The units move as if they were a single living organism.
And what makes this possible is the commander standing at the front lines.
Me
(I consider myself good at command too, but... this person is truly amazing...)
Holding a sense of awe in my heart, I steel my resolve once more.
Me
Balalaika, the large demon is likely an Ogre Slave.
Balalaika
The target from the intel. Huge and strong, but low intelligence. We were to use special warheads from long range, correct?
Me
Yes. There is also a report that several low-ranking Lust Demons are infiltrating the units.
Balalaika
I see. What is the countermeasure for that?
Me
They use charm spells, but we should handle them from long range as well. Standard warheads can still deal effective damage.
Balalaika
Understood. All units, maintain strict engagement distances.
Subordinates
Understood!
As soon as the orders are given, the responses come back immediately.
Furthermore, without any delay in their replies, the units deploy exactly as instructed.
Thanks to precise unit management, our losses appear minor, but the damage inflicted on the enemy is not that significant either.
Me
So the mafia members are at the front, with the demons occasionally joining the battle line for show... is that the situation?
Balalaika
That's right. Since it is technically the mafia's fight, they are up front, but they rely heavily on the demons' abilities.
Balalaika
On the other hand, for the demons, we are just one trading partner. They have no intention of acting aggressively in the open.
Because she knows this, Balalaika strikes first to suppress the enemy's momentum.
But because the countermeasures are so perfect, this speed of advance looks less cautious and more passive.
And, my doubts had already been seen through.
Balalaika
You have a look on your face that wonders why I am not pushing the attack harder.
Me
Yes, but... you have your reasons, don't you?
Balalaika
I just told you about the relationship between the enemy organizations. Both prioritize their own group over the other. Given time, cracks will form.
Me
You are trying to make their cooperation collapse?
Suppressing our own losses while causing the enemy to self-destruct.
If realized, it would be the ideal way to operate a unit, but it is easier said than done.
However, the soldiers of Hotel Moscow deeply understand the individual operations, so they react quickly to orders and move with precision.
Me
So, by sharing the operational intent across the entire unit, they are able to execute such advanced maneuvers...
Balalaika
That is right. It is because the individual skills of the comrades and the organizational strength mesh together.
She states it matter-of-factly, but I am impressed by the high level of organizational strength and the ability to bring it all together.
And soon, the effects of the operation manifested.
Balalaika
I see, understood, Sergeant. Everyone! The time has come! Commence the general assault!
The moment she received a single radio transmission, her expression, which had been calmly assessing the battlefield, changed drastically.
With a ferocious command that could be mistaken for a beast's roar, fierce voices rose from all around.
Subordinate
Uraaa!
Intense gunfire and the sound of military boots kicking up the ground echoed as the front line was pushed forward in unison.
Balalaika
Right wing, deploy a curtain of fire with special warheads! The area you push into is the main force's firing line! Do not let the curtain break; annihilate them!
Balalaika
The second wave that has flanked, do not let the remaining enemies escape! Prioritize striking the demons, and slaughter the cowed mafia!
Orders flew one after another, and with each one, gunfire and screams rose.
Though her standing posture did not budge, I involuntarily took a step back, as if a gun barrel were pressed against me.
This fierce demeanor must be the true form of a commander.
While I was overwhelmed and could do nothing, the enemies were subdued in the blink of an eye.
Subordinate 1
Right wing, all demons subdued!
Subordinate 2
Enemy main force suppressed! Leader and members captured!
Balalaika
Well done. You have my thanks.
Subordinates
Yes, ma'am!
As I listened to the report, a thin trail of purple smoke curled slowly from her lips, which offered only a brief word of commendation.
Her lipstick-coated lips were curved in a smile, but there was no trace of gentleness in her expression.
Me
(She looks like a wild beast...)
I felt a sense of dread and found myself falling silent.
Her gaze slowly turned toward me.
Balalaika
The battle is over. Our casualties are minor.
Me
Y-Yes! Understood! Thank you!
I straightened my back involuntarily and bowed my head sharply.
Seeing me like that, Balalaika's expression softened just a little.
Balalaika
Ah. It is good that you are leaving the aftermath to us, yes?
Me
Yes, please take care of it.
The tension had eased somewhat, but the atmosphere of the battlefield had not yet fully dissipated.
Balalaika
As you likely know, operating a unit is not just about combat. Keep a close eye on the movements of your personnel.
Where she gestured, the squad members who had participated in the fight were already beginning to withdraw swiftly.
Some were carrying the wounded in pairs, while others were escorting the captured prisoners back.
They remained vigilant of their surroundings while coordinating with one another, gradually merging to ensure greater safety.
There was no waste or hesitation in their movements; it was clear at a glance that these were veterans.
I could not even imagine how much training and how many harrowing situations they must have endured to reach this level.
Me
(They are letting me learn how a high-level unit operates.)
Thinking back, Taimanin unit operations rarely involve large groups.
However, with my coordination with the UCOA increasing, it has become urgent for me to learn how to operate on a larger scale.
Me
--I see. That is why Professor Asagi told me to come to the field.
Balalaika
Heh, so you noticed.
Me
Yes, thank you!
Balalaika
Asagi has told me the same. ... To care for her students so deeply. That is what it means to be both a warrior and a teacher.
Me
She is a teacher I can respect!
I nodded vigorously, bowing my head in my heart.
I wanted to repay her kindness by making use of what I had gained here.
Perhaps my inner feelings had leaked out, because Balalaika's expression softened even further.
Balalaika
Now then, the engagement is over. Let us each file our reports, and then I would like you to keep me company for a while.
Balalaika patted my back and exhaled a plume of purple smoke from her smiling mouth.
